summary: January 2026 adds an aap.auth_audit logger with source IP and user agent, logging OAuth2 token lifecycle, authenticated API requests, SSO redirects and failures, SAML, login successes and failures and claims denials; these logs will later appear only in aap.auth_audit. Also clearer authenticator mapping labels.
questions: How do I audit login attempts in AAP?
Does AAP log OAuth2 token usage?
Will authentication logs move to aap.auth_audit only?

answer_card.title: aap.auth_audit logger
answer_card.answer_md:
Added January 2026. Logs include source IP and user agent and cover:
- OAuth2 token creation, modification and use, plus authenticated API requests
- SSO redirects, social auth failures, SAML events
- Successful and failed logins, no-authenticator cases, claims-based denials

These entries also stay in their old loggers for now; a future release will keep them **only** in `aap.auth_audit`.
